mapper.select: SELECT id FROM fcc_call_session WHERE id=#{callId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_agent_service_session(id,call_id,leg_id,agent_id,sequence_no,service_role, agent_name_snapshot,work_no_snapshot,endpoint_snapshot,status,ringing_at,answered_at,ended_at,result) SELECT #{participationId},l.call_id,l.id,a.id, COALESCE((SELECT sequence_no FROM fcc_agent_service_session existing WHERE existing.leg_id=l.id), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no),0)+1 FROM fcc_agent_service_session numbered WHERE numbered.call_id=l.call_id)), 'PRIMARY',a.agent_name,a.work_no,l.endpoint_id, CASE WHEN l.state='DESTROY' AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ENDED' WHEN l.answered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ANSWERED' ELSE 'RINGING' END, l.ringing_at,l.answered_at,l.ended_at,l.hangup_cause FROM fcc_call_leg l JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.work_no=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.metadata,'$.agentWorkNo')) WHERE l.id=#{legId} AND l.role_type='AGENT' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ringing_at=COALESCE(fcc_agent_service_session.ringing_at,VALUES(ringing_at)), answered_at=COALESCE(fcc_agent_service_session.answered_at,VALUES(answered_at)), ended_at=COALESCE(fcc_agent_service_session.ended_at,VALUES(ended_at)), status=CASE WHEN fcc_agent_service_session.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ENDED' WHEN fcc_agent_service_session.answered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ANSWERED' ELSE VALUES(status) END, result=COALESCE(fcc_agent_service_session.result,VALUES(result)), version=fcc_agent_service_session.version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_service_session s JOIN fcc_call_leg l ON l.id=s.leg_id SET s.status='ENDED',s.ended_at=COALESCE(s.ended_at,l.ended_at), s.result=COALESCE(s.result,l.hangup_cause),s.version=s.version+1,s.updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE s.call_id IN #{callId} AND l.state='DESTROY' AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.status!='ENDED' OR s.ended_at IS NULL)
